title: Ukraine’s Starshield Access Is Being Restricted Again, Zelensky Says
summary_full: President Volodymyr Zelensky said the system, which Ukraine uses to guide drones, was being throttled over Russian-occupied territory. SpaceX, its developer, has denied the claim.
